messages:
oncall-ops-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: ap-southeast2 region health probes failing (control-plane heartbeats missing). 0/3 controllers responding. Created incident INC-2026-0456. Paging oncall.

sophie: seeing a spike of 502s from the edge in ap-southeast2, dashboards show control-plane API 504s. Customers reporting inference timeouts.

raj: vpc flow logs show massive SYN retries to controller IPs, also BGP neighbors show withdrawals for a subset of racks. Not seeing host-level OOMs.

leo: starting runbook "region-blackhole" steps. Step 1: confirm control-plane API unreachable from controlplane-proxy.

leo: curl output from controlplane VIP:
```
$ curl -sv https://ap-southeast2-control.redwood.internal/health
* Connected to ap-southeast2-control ...
* Empty reply from server
curl: (52) Empty reply from server
```

emily: initiating traffic-shift plan: lowering DNS TTL for model endpoints in ap-southeast2 and bumping weight to ap-southeast1 in traffic-router. Will do staged 10% -> 50% -> 100% unless errors.

network-eng: if BGP withdraws are true we might have an underlay blackhole. I'm spinning up a jittered traceroute to edge gateways and tagging network oncall.

chris: blocking note: Dedicated customers with reserved capacity in ap-southeast2 — moving them will require coordination with billing and SLA teams. If we fail traffic-shift we'll need to enable cross-region failover on dedicated pools (manual).

sophie: autoscaler attempted to spawn replacement pods but failed with "cannot reach apiserver". So control-plane partition prevents k8s-based remediation.

raj: confirming etcd leader election logs show repeated timeouts. Looks like control-plane nodes lost interconnect. Not safe to restart nodes right now.

leo: decision proposal: declare P0, escalate to infra-pager, start staged DNS weight shift + failover routes for hosted model traffic. Notify Dedicated accounts ops immediately.

emily: starting 10% traffic shift now -> monitor 1 min.

oncall-ops-bot: ACTIONS: INC-2026-0456 created, runbook link https://confluence.redwood/INC-2026-0456-runbook, notify: infra-pager, product-ops, support-escalations. Tagging execs if >30m.

network-eng: traceroutes show last hop blackhole in peering fabric for two edge PoPs. Opening ticket with cloud provider NOC and attaching logs.

chris: added temporary cost estimate: cross-region egress + burst capacity ~ $3-6k/hr while we run failover. FYI to finance oncall.

sophie: 10% shift shows 2% error delta, RTT improved for shifted traffic. continuing to 50% in 5m if stable.

raj: continuing to collect controller and etcd logs, attaching snippets in incident. Do not attempt rolling restarts until we confirm interconnect stable.

leo: roles: sophie -> traffic shift ops, raj -> control-plane logs & diagnostics, emily -> customer comms for hosted, chris -> dedicated accounts & finance, network-eng -> provider NOC liaison.

emily: preparing a short customer status note: "We detected a regional network incident affecting ap-southeast2. We're shifting traffic and will post updates every 15m."

oncall-ops-bot: Next update scheduled in 10m. Escalation level: P0, exec notify threshold set at 30m.
